mentions.name: GamingCouch
mentions.description: A web-based local multiplayer party game platform, described as a lovechild of Jackbox Games and Mario Party, currently in free Early Access with 18 competitive mini-games. Players use their mobile phones (or game pads) as controllers, everything runs in the browser with no downloads or installs, and games support up to 8 players in action-based rounds of about one minute with no language-based trivia or asynchronous games. The platform plans to open up to third-party developers and game jams, handling network connectivity and controllers so third-party devs can focus on building multiplayer mini-games.
mentions.problem: Third-party developers building multiplayer mini-games would otherwise spend an eternity on networking code and building infrastructure; the platform takes care of network connectivity and controllers for them.
mentions.audience: Party game players (up to 8 per game) using mobile phones or game pads as controllers, plus (in the future) third-party developers building multiplayer mini-games.
